For your mom, use "con" (a child speaking to a parent). For others, swap in "em" or "mình" depending on who it's for, so I can make a second version if you want.

ok good. now how do i turn on the voicemail to text thing, just the steps

Steps (iPhone):
1. Open Phone, then the Voicemail tab.
2. Tap a voicemail. If transcription is available, the text appears under it.
3. If it doesn't, go to Settings > Phone > Visual Voicemail and check that it's set up.

Android:
1. Open Phone, then Voicemail.
2. Tap Settings (the three dots), then Voicemail.
3. Turn on Visual Voicemail or Transcription if it's listed.

If neither option shows up, your carrier may not support it. Tell me who it is and I'll find the right step.
